newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Hero sees strong 1997 oper profit growth.
newsitem.headline: Hero sees strong 1997 oper profit growth.

text.p: Swiss food and beverage maker Hero AG said it expected double-digit growth in operating profit in 1997 on sales of around 1.8 billion Swiss francs.

In remarks prepared for delivery to reporters, chief executive Lutz Peters said Hero, majority owned by German foods group Schwartau International GmbH, sought to improve margins in its food business and post a profit in its beverages division.

Hero's 1996 group operating profit rose 26.4 percent to 88.5 million on sales on 1.84 billion, up 27.9 percent. Group net slipped to 31.9 million from 35.6 million, mainly due to restructuring charges.
